slides.0.title: Course Introduction
slides.0.content: Touraine White Wine Quadrangle — This course covers Cheverny, Cour-Cheverny, Valençay, Touraine-Amboise (white), and Touraine-Azay-le-Rideau, exploring the geography, soils, varieties, and stylistic characteristics of each AOC.
slides.1.title: Touraine White Wine Quadrangle
slides.1.content:
This course systematically explores the terroir characteristics of Cheverny, Cour-Cheverny, Valençay, Touraine-Amboise (white), and Touraine-Azay-le-Rideau, helping you build a solid knowledge framework for the Loire Valley.

Through systematic study, you will be able to identify the typical styles of these AOCs and accurately describe their characteristics during tasting.
slides.2.title: Quiz
slides.2.questions.0.question: Which of the following AOCs is covered in this course?
slides.2.questions.0.explanation: Cheverny is an important AOC in the Loire Valley and a core subject of this course. Located south of Blois, it mainly produces Sauvignon Blanc + Chardonnay blended whites, and Gamay + Pinot Noir reds. Cour-Cheverny is a sub-AOC exclusively using the rare Romorantin variety.
